study type: Validation study using retrospective claims data review
exposure: Claims-based algorithms (diagnosis/procedure codes) for identifying non-live births
outcome: Positive predictive value (PPV) for spontaneous abortion
cohort: A cohort of women enrolled in Medicaid who had a non-live birth, identified from the Mass General Brigham Research Patient Data Registry between 2000 and 2014.
finding: Claims-based algorithms can identify non-live birth outcomes (stillbirth, spontaneous abortion, termination) in healthcare utilization databases with good positive predictive values, which improved with refined definitions.
